[IDAT.6.2.1] Activations are allocated by the agenda module
when the Rete network completes a pattern match, and
freed when that match ends: a fact it matched is
retracted, or a test it passed no longer admits it.
Firing does not free one. A fired activation stays,
carrying the fired flag, until its match ends
([IDAT.6.2.2]), so an activation is not bounded by the
pump that made it.
